steps.title: Two sorting rules

options.label: A red car is red and has wheels. Which sorting group fits it?
A green leaf is not red and has no wheels. Which group fits it?
Put ten in a sorting box: is ten less than ten?

steps.hint: Ask separately: is it red? Does it have wheels? Two yes answers mean both.
steps.explanation: Ask both sorting questions, including both and neither.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Two sorting rules
mathWorkshop.goal: Ask both sorting questions, including both and neither.

tasks.prompt: A red car is red and has wheels. Which sorting group fits it?
tasks.feedback: Both rules are true. A red car belongs in the overlap.
tasks.hint: Ask separately: is it red? Does it have wheels? Two yes answers mean both.

tasks.prompt: A green leaf is not red and has no wheels. Which group fits it?
tasks.feedback: Neither rule is true. The green leaf belongs outside both hoops.
tasks.hint: Neither means that both sorting questions have a no answer.

tasks.prompt: Put ten in a sorting box: is ten less than ten?
tasks.feedback: Ten is equal to ten. It is not less than ten.
tasks.hint: Less than means smaller. Equal is not smaller.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Both labels
steps.prompt: Which object belongs in both red and has wheels?
steps.hint: Ask two questions: is it red? Does it have wheels?
steps.explanation: A red car is red and has wheels, so it fits both labels.
steps.shortExplanation: A red car is red and has wheels, so it fits both labels.

steps.title: The overlap
steps.prompt: Why does the red car belong in the overlap?

options.label: It is red and has wheels.

steps.hint: Check the car against each label in turn.
steps.explanation: The overlap is for objects that fit both labels.
steps.shortExplanation: The overlap is for objects that fit both labels.

source.answerKeyText: Because it is red and it has wheels — it fits both labels.

steps.title: Neither label
steps.prompt: Choose the objects that fit neither red nor has wheels.
steps.hint: Find the things that are not red and have no wheels.
steps.explanation: The green leaf and blue ball are not red and have no wheels.
steps.shortExplanation: The green leaf and blue ball are not red and have no wheels.

source.answerKeyText: the green leaf or the blue ball — both are outside both hoops.

steps.title: Carroll diagram
steps.prompt: Sort the numbers into the Carroll diagram.
steps.hint: For each number ask: is it less than 10? Think about 10 itself.
steps.explanation: 10 is not less than 10. It belongs with 12, 15 and 18.
steps.shortExplanation: 10 is not less than 10. It belongs with 12, 15 and 18.

steps.title: Children with cats
steps.prompt: How many children have a cat?
steps.hint: Count the blocks in the cat column.
steps.explanation: Each block is one child. The cat column has 5.
steps.shortExplanation: Each block is one child. The cat column has 5.

steps.title: More cats than dogs
steps.prompt: How many more cats than dogs?
steps.hint: Count both columns, then find the difference.
steps.explanation: There are 5 cats and 3 dogs. The difference is 2.
steps.shortExplanation: There are 5 cats and 3 dogs. The difference is 2.

steps.title: Fitting both labels
steps.prompt: An object that fits both labels belongs in the overlap.
steps.hint: Where do the two hoops share space?
steps.explanation: Both labels are true in the overlap.
steps.shortExplanation: Both labels are true in the overlap.

steps.title: Not red, no wheels
steps.prompt: Which one is not red and has no wheels?
steps.hint: Ask two questions: is it red? Does it have wheels? Two no answers mean outside.
steps.explanation: A banana is yellow and has no wheels, so it goes outside both hoops.
steps.shortExplanation: A banana is yellow and has no wheels, so it goes outside both hoops.

source.answerKeyText: Anything that is not red and has no wheels, e.g. a yellow banana, a book.

steps.title: Venn overlap
steps.prompt: The overlap in a Venn diagram is for things that are...
steps.hint: The overlap is inside both hoops at once.
steps.explanation: The overlap is inside both hoops, so things there fit both labels.
steps.shortExplanation: The overlap is inside both hoops, so things there fit both labels.

steps.title: Where 10 goes
steps.hint: Is 10 less than 10, or the same?
steps.explanation: 10 is the same as 10, so it is not less than 10.
steps.shortExplanation: 10 is the same as 10, so it is not less than 10.

steps.title: Outside the hoops
steps.prompt: Things that fit neither label go...
steps.hint: If a thing fits no hoop, where can it go?
steps.explanation: Things that fit neither label go outside both hoops.
steps.shortExplanation: Things that fit neither label go outside both hoops.

steps.title: Each block
steps.prompt: In the pets block graph, each block stands for...
steps.hint: Read the words under the graph.
steps.explanation: Each block in the pets graph stands for one child.
steps.shortExplanation: Each block in the pets graph stands for one child.

steps.title: The tallest column
steps.hint: More blocks make a taller column.
steps.explanation: The tallest column has the most blocks, so it is most popular.
steps.shortExplanation: The tallest column has the most blocks, so it is most popular.

stickers.meaning: Sorting hoops with an overlap for things that fit both labels.

homeActivities.text: Make two overlapping loops with scarves: red and has wheels. Sort toys into red only, wheels only, both and neither. Sort number cards around 10.
homeActivities.textAr: اعملوا دايرتين متداخلين بإيشاربين: واحدة «أحمر» وواحدة «ليه عجل». قسّموا اللعب: أحمر بس، ليه عجل بس، الاتنين، ولا ده ولا ده. وقسّموا كروت أرقام: أقل من ١٠ وأكتر من ١٠.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
